findings.review: Black felt bicorne with restrained gold woven edging, tricolor cockade and plain button added below instrument beside tripod. Telescope remains dominant; main circle, arc, compass, mount and three-leg structure remain visually coherent. One lower leg partly concealed by hat, not removed. Colors remain individually natural. Alpha exterior and gaps reviewed. Hat silhouette distinct at 48/64 px, simplified at 32 px.
findings.limits: Targeted generative edit, not a pixel-exact preservation of the instrument. Museum hat attributed to a general with engineer background, not an exclusive corps uniform or universal issue; stylized interpretation, not exact reproduction. Gold border does not function as engineering insignia. No in-game test.
